data.title: One strategy document; direct personal outreach is the primary acquisition motion until the Probe B verdict
data.why: Seven strategy documents disagreed on call length, post count, dates and thresholds, and none of them produced a single message between Sep 8 and Sep 16. The owner chose to write to people directly on LinkedIn and other networks; a free MIT tool with no telemetry and a closed search term cannot buy, track or search its way to users, so talking to them by hand is the only channel that answers the unvalidated bet.
data.rejected: Keep gtm-first-users.md as the plan and only update its dates; Community posts and one Show HN as the main motion before any interviews
